mapper.update: UPDATE places SET title=#{title},place_group=#{placeGroup},category=#{category},address=#{address},latitude=#{latitude},longitude=#{longitude},timezone=#{timezone},phone=#{phone},website=#{website},thumbnail=#{thumbnail},images=#{images},destinations=#{destinations}::jsonb,descriptions=#{descriptions},attributes=#{attributes}::jsonb,data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND primary_source_type='PARTNER' AND data_version=#{dataVersion} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM place_sources s WHERE s.place_id=places.id AND s.source_type='PARTNER' AND s.source_owner_id=#{organizationId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_sources(id,place_id,source_type,source_owner_id,source_status,first_seen_at,last_seen_at,last_successful_sync_at,schema_version,created_at,updated_at)VALUES(#{id},#{placeId},'PARTNER',#{organizationId},'ACTIVE',#{now},#{now},#{now},1,#{now},#{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM place_sources WHERE place_id=#{placeId} AND source_type='PARTNER' AND source_owner_id=#{organizationId}
SELECT p.*,s.source_owner_id AS organization_id FROM places p JOIN place_sources s ON s.place_id=p.id AND s.source_type='PARTNER' AND s.source_owner_id=#{organizationId} WHERE p.id=#{id}
SELECT p.*,s.source_owner_id AS organization_id FROM places p JOIN place_sources s ON s.place_id=p.id AND s.source_type='PARTNER' AND s.source_owner_id=#{organizationId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
